title: Maelstrom 20L Insulated Lunch Bag, Black-Aqua

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer's own store, same 20L double-deck insulated lunch bag in Black-aqua, model MSLB06 (SKU DW06-MSLB06-20LAQBK), in stock at $31.99.

writeup: Woot has the Maelstrom 20L insulated lunch bag in Black-aqua, new, for $9.99. Maelstrom's own store charges $31.99 for the same bag, model MSLB06, so this is about 68% less. It has a split double-deck layout with a leakproof lining and a quick-access flip lid. Only one was left when we checked, with a limit of three per customer.
